executive_summary.problem_statement: Small retailers lose $50,000 annually due to inventory mismanagement, stockouts, and overstocking. Manual tracking is error-prone and time-consuming.
executive_summary.solution_overview: InventoryAI Pro uses machine learning to predict demand, automate reordering, and provide real-time inventory visibility across all sales channels.
executive_summary.target_audience: Small and medium-sized retail businesses with 1-50 locations
executive_summary.unique_value_proposition: Reduce stockouts by 90% and cut inventory costs by 25% with AI-powered predictions

key_risks.mitigation: Focus on early adopter segments, offer extended trials
Differentiate on AI capabilities and ease of use

key_risks: Data quality issues in customer systems
executive_summary.recommendation: Proceed with MVP development targeting convenience stores as initial beachhead market.

customer_research.target_customer: Independent convenience store owners aged 35-55, managing 1-3 locations, currently using spreadsheets or basic POS systems for inventory

pain_signals.description: Spending 10+ hours weekly on manual inventory counts
pain_signals.impact: Direct labor cost and opportunity cost

pain_signals.signal: Frequent stockouts of popular items leading to lost sales

pain_signals.description: Overstocking of slow-moving items tying up capital
No visibility into inventory across multiple locations

job_to_be_done.trigger_situation: When a customer asks for a product and the shelf is empty
job_to_be_done.underlying_goal: Never lose a sale due to stockout while minimizing capital tied up in inventory
job_to_be_done.success_definition: Zero stockouts for top 100 SKUs and 20% reduction in inventory holding costs

market_context.tam: $50 billion globally for retail inventory management
market_context.sam: $12 billion in North American SMB retail

market_hypotheses.hypothesis: SMB retailers will pay $200+/month for AI-powered inventory management
market_hypotheses.validation: Survey of 150 store owners showed 68% willingness to pay

market_hypotheses.hypothesis: Integration with existing POS systems is critical for adoption
market_hypotheses.validation: User interviews revealed this as top 3 requirement

uncomfortable_insights: Many target customers are skeptical of AI claims due to past vendor overpromises
Price sensitivity is higher than initially assumed - $99/month may be ceiling for smallest stores

uncomfortable_insights.insight: Competitors are rapidly adding similar features
uncomfortable_insights.implication: Window of differentiation may be 12-18 months

competitive_landscape.market_position: Emerging challenger in fragmented market dominated by legacy solutions

competitors.name: Square for Retail
competitors.description: Part of Square ecosystem, strong brand recognition

competitive_landscape.differentiation: Only solution with true predictive AI for demand forecasting at SMB price point

problem: Manual inventory tracking is time-consuming and error-prone
Stockouts cause lost sales and customer frustration
Overstocking ties up capital and leads to waste
lean_canvas.unique_value_proposition: Reduce stockouts by 90% and cut inventory costs by 25% with AI-powered predictions that learn your business
unfair_advantage: Proprietary ML models trained on retail data
Team with 20+ years retail technology experience
Early mover in SMB AI inventory space
channels: Direct sales with inside sales team

market_sizing.tam: $50B - Global retail inventory management software market
market_sizing.som: $600M - Achievable in 5 years with focused execution

revenue_streams.name: Core Subscription
revenue_streams.description: Monthly access to AI inventory management platform

revenue_streams.name: Auto-Order Commission
revenue_streams.description: Small percentage on automated purchase orders

revenue_streams.name: Premium Support
revenue_streams.description: Dedicated account manager and priority support

cost_structure.description: AWS/GCP hosting, ML compute, data storage

business_case.gtm_strategy: Land and expand strategy starting with convenience stores in urban areas. Partner with POS vendors for distribution. Build case studies and leverage word-of-mouth in tight-knit retail communities.
business_case.pricing_strategy: Freemium model with 14-day full-featured trial. Three tiers: Starter ($99/mo for single location), Growth ($249/mo for 2-5 locations), Enterprise (custom pricing for 6+ locations).

product_requirements_document.product_vision: To become the intelligent brain behind every small retailer's inventory decisions, eliminating the guesswork and manual effort from stock management.
goals: Launch MVP within 6 months targeting convenience stores
Achieve 100 paying customers within 3 months of launch
Demonstrate measurable ROI (20%+ inventory cost reduction) for early customers
Build foundation for expansion to adjacent retail verticals

epics.title: Core Inventory Management
epics.description: Basic inventory tracking, stock levels, and manual adjustments
user_stories: As a store owner, I want to see current stock levels
As a store owner, I want to record inventory adjustments

epics.title: AI Demand Prediction
epics.description: Machine learning models to predict demand and suggest reorder points
user_stories: As a store owner, I want to see predicted demand for next week

epics.title: POS Integration
epics.description: Connect with popular POS systems to sync sales data automatically

epics.title: Mobile App
epics.description: iOS and Android apps for on-the-go inventory management

functional_requirements.requirement: System shall track inventory levels in real-time with 99.9% accuracy
System shall generate demand forecasts with at least 85% accuracy for top SKUs

functional_requirements.description: System shall integrate with Square, Clover, and Toast POS systems

functional_requirements: System shall send low-stock alerts via email and push notifications
System shall support barcode scanning for inventory updates

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Page load times under 2 seconds for 95th percentile

non_functional_requirements: SOC 2 Type II compliance within 18 months
product_requirements_document.mvp_scope: Single-location inventory tracking with demand prediction for top 100 SKUs. Square POS integration only. Web app only (mobile in v2). Email alerts only.
success_criteria: 100 paying customers within 90 days of launch
Average customer achieves 20% reduction in stockouts

technical_architecture.architecture_overview: Cloud-native microservices architecture on AWS. Event-driven design with real-time data processing for inventory updates. ML models served via dedicated inference endpoints.

key_components.name: Inventory Service
key_components.description: Core service managing stock levels, adjustments, and history

key_components.name: Prediction Engine
key_components.description: ML service for demand forecasting and reorder recommendations

key_components.name: Integration Hub
key_components.description: Handles connections to external POS systems and suppliers

integration_points.name: Square POS
integration_points.description: Real-time sales data sync via webhook

security_considerations: All data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
Role-based access control for multi-user accounts
PCI DSS compliance for any payment-related data
technical_architecture.scalability_approach: Horizontal scaling via Kubernetes with auto-scaling based on request volume. Database read replicas for query-heavy workloads. Caching layer (Redis) for frequently accessed inventory data.

data_protection.summary: Standard data protection measures required. No sensitive PII collected. Inventory and sales data subject to customer data agreements.
data_protection.requirements: Data processing agreements with customers. Clear data retention policies. Secure deletion procedures.

risks.risk: Data breach exposing customer inventory/sales data
risks.title: Data Security
risks.mitigation: Encryption, access controls, regular audits, cyber insurance

risks.risk: Incorrect predictions leading to business losses
risks.mitigation: Clear disclaimers, gradual rollout, human approval for large orders

legal_regulatory_review.ip_considerations: Core ML algorithms are proprietary trade secrets. Patent applications filed for novel demand prediction methods. All employee/contractor IP assigned to company.
legal_regulatory_review.compliance_roadmap: Phase 1: Basic CCPA compliance at launch. Phase 2: SOC 2 Type I within 12 months. Phase 3: SOC 2 Type II within 18 months. Phase 4: GDPR compliance before EU expansion.
